title: Only 28% of Hyderabad trips use public transport

slides.head: Only 28% of Hyderabad trips use public transport
What happened
slides.body: Verma spoke at Hyderabad Metro Rail Bhavan on lessons from London for the city's traffic.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: He said road widening and flyovers give limited relief; metro, buses and footpaths are needed.

slides.head: Did you know
slides.body: Verma said the share should eventually go beyond 60%.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: What the 'Cyberabad Moves' drive asks of IT commuters. Ask: What would get single-occupancy car users onto the Metro or buses?

captions.instagram:
Only 28% of Hyderabad trips use public transport

Transport for London CTO Shashi Verma said Hyderabad must raise public transport's share of daily travel to at least 40%.

Why it matters: He said road widening and flyovers give limited relief; metro, buses and footpaths are needed.
